jordan: Quick Q — lichen-7b just showed up in the model catalog. License page says `CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0` plus an extra line: 'No hosting for commercial services'. Can we onboard this for hosted API or Dedicated?
priya: link?
jordan: https://models.example/lichen-7b (license snippet below)
```
License: CC-BY-NC-SA 4.0
Additional: No hosting for commercial services; commercial redistribution prohibited without express written permission.
```
samir: if that additional sentence is enforceable, hosted inference for customers is a hard no. Dedicated (reserved capacity) where customer controls keys/data might also be tricky if we ship quantized weights.
olivia-legal: @jordan @samir thanks — short answer: we need to interpret two things separately: (1) "No hosting" clause and whether it overrides the CC license, and (2) whether delivering quantized/converted weights counts as "redistribution" under SA.
olivia-legal: CC-BY-NC-SA requires derivatives to be shared under same terms when distributed. If we materially convert weights (quantize/opt kernels) and *distribute* them (e.g., ship a binary weight tar to a customer or put into a downloadable container), that's distribution and SA could trigger.
olivia-legal: However, providing an API (you serving model from our infra) is typically *not* distribution under plain CC, but the extra 'No hosting for commercial services' could explicitly block that — it's an additional restriction and we must treat it as binding unless author clarifies.
priya: so options are: (a) ask author for a hosting exception or commercial license, (b) use model only for internal evals/research (not customer-facing), (c) enable customer-managed private deployment where we don't hand over artifacts (but still risky), or (d) avoid altogether.
samir: technically we could run evals in private sandbox cluster and do quantization experiments there, but we must not push quantized checkpoints out. :thumbsup:
jordan: action: i'll set up an isolated eval env and add a blocker on onboarding checklist for legal sign-off.
olivia-legal: I'll draft an email to the model author asking for clarification and a commercial hosting carve-out. If they refuse, we should not: (1) offer hosted API, (2) ship quantized weights, or (3) include the model in any redistributable package.
license-bot: Created LEGAL-4522 — "lichen-7b licensing clarification request" (assignee: olivia-legal).
jordan: thanks — marking onboarding PR as blocked until LEGAL-4522 resolved. :slightly_smiling_face:
priya: FYI i'll capture the eval prompts and metric baseline in the ticket so we can resume quickly once legal clears.
samir: one more tech note: even if hosting is permitted, we should add a config flag to disable weight export and add telemetry to ensure no accidental distribution. small patch but saves headaches.
ojordan: ack (typo fix)
jordan: (edited) all set — will ping when email reply comes back.
